decisions.reason: Devore decoration fabrics are fashion-driven collection items that are often rotated after a few seasons, but a variant range launched in 2019 can still sell. The energy-cost squeeze of 2022 adds some pressure to prune it.
Transparent burnout sheers follow design trends and face collection renewal. Without evidence of failure, the firm likely keeps it for another season.
This burnout decorative fabric overlaps with the other burnout lines, which makes it a pruning candidate. It is still likely retained while the collection runs its usual cycle.
Velour-like upholstery fabrics have steadier demand in furniture and contract markets than sheer fashion fabrics, so the firm likely keeps it.
Flame-retardant fabrics serve certified contract and hospitality markets with long product lifecycles. Certification is a sunk investment, so dropping it is unlikely.
A polyester satin lining is a staple basic with continuous demand that complements the decorative range, so the firm should keep it.
